"''Never. We hardly know each other.|Neepers Panpick and Lexo Sooger|}} '''Neepers Panpick''' was an [[Neepers Panpick's species|alien]] private detective who operated in the [[city]] of [[Canto Bight]] during the [[Cold War]] between the [[First Order]] and the [[Resistance]]. He was friends with the masseur [[Lexo Sooger]], and when Sooger's adopted daughter [[Lula Sooger|Lula]] was kidnapped by the [[crime lord]] [[Sturg Ganna]], Panpick gave advice to his friend on how to save her and pointed him toward the [[Canto Casino Hotel]]. Sooger later sent a copy of a [[datapad]] that held details of all Ganna's illegal dealings to Panpick as leverage against Ganna in order to prevent the crime lord from [[Death|killing]] him and Lula. In the [[Standard year|year]] [[34 ABY]], the detective was present in the [[Canto Casino and Racetrack|Canto Casino]] when the Resistance agents [[Finn]] and [[Rose Tico]] arrived searching for the [[Master Codebreaker]]. ==Biography== ===The Canto Bight gumshoe=== {{Quote|Last week, some rich heiress lost her pet—an overgrown rat with three tails, all dyed different colors. I found the poor thing hiding out near the countess's estate.|Panpick describes a recent case|}} Neepers Panpick was an [[alien]] [[Gender|male]] who worked as a private detective during the [[Cold War]] between the [[First Order]] and the [[Resistance]]. He was based out of an office in the high-rent part of [[Old Town (Canto Bight)|Old City]], a district of the [[city]] of [[Canto Bight]] on the [[planet]] [[Cantonica]]. Although he was not wealthy, Panpick would occasionally visit the expensive [[Zord's Spa and Bathhouse]], where he made friends with the [[Dor Namethian]] masseur [[Lexo Sooger]], whom he would always request. One client who hired Panpick was a [[Unidentified rich heiress|rich heiress]] who had lost her pet in Canto Bight. Panpick was able to located the pet hiding near the estate of [[Count|Contessa]] [[Alissyndrex delga Cantonica Provincion]], and upon returning it to her, the heiress was so pleased she doubled the detective's reward for the job. Panpick then used the money to pay for a [[ceiling fan]] for his office and a new [[Clothing|suit]]. ===A friend in need=== {{Quote|Once I know where to start, I have a…a trail of sorts that I can follow. I just need that start. I guess it's hard to expl—''"
"The casino hotel.|Sooger asks Panpick for help|}} [[File:LexoSooger.png|thumb|left|Neepers Panpick aided his friend Lexo Sooger.|169x169px]] A [[Standard week|week]] after Panpick helped the heiress, Sooger's adopted daughter [[Lula Sooger|Lula]] was kidnapped by the [[crime lord]] [[Sturg Ganna]] and so the masseur traveled to Panpick's office to ask for advice. He found Panpick sat at his desk while a live feed of the entrance to the [[Canto Casino and Racetrack|Canto Casino]] played to the detective's left, which Sooger assumed was surveillance from the [[Canto Bight Police Department]] that Panpick had made a deal in order to receive. Once Sooger had explained what had happened, he forbid Panpick to directly get involved due to the danger of opposing Ganna, instead asking that the detective give him a lead to start his mission to save Lula. Panpick directed him to the entrance of the [[Canto Casino Hotel]], where he knew that Ganna owned a suite. The detective then shared his deductions about where the suite would most likely be and advice on how Sooger should proceed. He also gifted the masseur three [[cantocoin]]s to help with funding the rescue and then after the pair discussed Panpick's new ceiling fan, Sooger left. ===Leverage holder=== {{Quote|Send it to Neepers Panpick, Private Investigator, along with a message that if we don't check in with him tomorrow, he should release the information citywide.|Sooger tells Lula to send the information on Ganna to Panpick|}} [[File:Panpick_Casino.png|thumb|right|Panpick spent time at Canto Casino.|215x215px]] Sooger managed to successfully locate his daughter in Ganna's suite and discovered a [[datapad]] that detailed many of Ganna's illegal dealings. The masseur had Lula send it to Panpick as leverage against the crime lord, with orders to release it to the public if the pair failed to check in with him the following [[Standard day|day]]. This allowed them to escape Ganna's suite alive. In around the [[Standard year|year]] [[34 ABY]],''[[Star Wars: Galactic Atlas]]'' places the events of the film [[Star Wars: Episode VII The Force Awakens|''Star Wars'': Episode VII ''The Force Awakens'']] in [[34 ABY]]. As [[Star Wars: Episode VIII The Last Jedi|''Star Wars'': Episode VIII ''The Last Jedi'']] carries on immediately from the events of ''The Force Awakens'', it must also take place around 34 ABY. Panpick was speaking to an elderly [[human]] woman at a table in the [[Canto Casino and Racetrack|Canto Casino]] when the Resistance agents [[Finn]], [[Rose Tico]] and [[BB-8]] arrived in the [[casino]] in search of the [[Master Codebreaker]]. Panpick later encountered BB-8 while the [[droid]] was searching the casino, and stared down at the droid.''[[The Last Jedi: Rose and Finn's Secret Mission]]'' ==Personality and traits== {{Quote|Lula is missing.''"
"''Oh, sands, I'm so sorry to hear. Sit down, sit down. Tell me all about it.|Panpick shows genuine concern for his friend's plight|}} [[File:Neepers_Panpick.png|thumb|left|No one knew more about the secrets of Canto Bight's elite than Neepers Panpick.|211x211px]] Panpick was a short bipedal alien with a round, bald head and huge [[Color|black]] [[eye]]s that made him seem perpetually surprised. He had pink skin and brown [[Hair|whiskers]]. His voice was loud''[[Star Wars: The Last Jedi: Ultimate Sticker Collection]]'' high and thin, similar in sound to a squeaking [[bird]]. No one knew more than Panpick about the activities of Canto Bight's various power brokers and the secrets they kept.{{Databank|neepers-panpick|Neepers Panpick}} He was able to immediately deduce something was wrong when Sooger visited him, as the detective's friends only dropped by his office when they had a problem. He was genuinely concerned for the masseur and his daughter, but was initially relieved when Sooger forbid him to become directly involved in opposing Ganna. The detective's relief was quickly replaced by guilt, but then suspicion as to why Sooger had come at all if he wouldn't allow Panpick to help. As soon as Sooger asked for a lead, Panpick immediately provided him one and tried to offer as much advice and information as possible to his friend. He also donated money to Sooger, claiming it would held assuage his guilty conscience. ==Equipment== {{Quote|Paid for that fan and a new suit.|Panpick reveals what he did with the rich heiress's paycheck|}} Despite not being as wealthy as many other residents of Canto Bight, Panpick needed to dress to impress his clients and so wore a black [[velvet]] suit, a long, quilted vest and [[Boot|shoes]] in the perfect state of shine. He used a datapad while in his office. ==Behind the scenes== [[File:King_56.png|thumb|right|Concept art of Neepers Panpick was titled King 56.|169x169px]] Neepers Panpick was created for the film [[Star Wars: Episode VIII The Last Jedi|''Star Wars'': Episode VIII ''The Last Jedi'']] and was portrayed by [[Kiran Shah]]. Prior to the film's release on [[December 15]], [[2017]],{{SW|url=news/star-wars-episode-viii-to-open-december-15-2017|text=''Star Wars: Episode VIII'' to Open December 15, 2017}} the character was revealed on [[July 15]] in a behind the scenes video released on the official ''[[Star Wars]]'' [[Wikipedia:YouTube|YouTube]] channel.{{SWYouTube|ye6GCY_vqYk|Star Wars: The Last Jedi Behind The Scenes|sw_url=video/star-wars-the-last-jedi-behind-the-scenes}} He then appeared and was first named in the short story "[[Hear Nothing, See Nothing, Say Nothing]]," which was written by [[Rae Carson]] and released as part of the ''[[Journey to Star Wars: The Last Jedi]]'' on [[December 5]].{{SW|url=news/check-out-the-cover-and-new-details-of-journey-to-star-wars-the-last-jedi-canto-bight|text=Check Out the Cover and New Details of Journey to ''Star Wars: The Last Jedi'' - ''Canto Bight''}} Concept art of Panpick for his appearance in the film was drawn by creature concept designer [[Ivan Manzella]] and titled "King 56".''[[The Art of Star Wars: The Last Jedi]]'' ==Appearances== {{Mediacat|imagecat=Images of Neepers Panpick}} *{{StoryCite|story=Hear Nothing, See Nothing, Say Nothing|book=Canto Bight (novella collection)|audiobook=1}} {{1st}} *{{Film|VIII}} *''[[The Last Jedi: Rose and Finn's Secret Mission]]'' ==Sources== *{{SWYouTube|ye6GCY_vqYk|Star Wars: The Last Jedi Behind The Scenes|sw_url=video/star-wars-the-last-jedi-behind-the-scenes}} {{1stp}} *''[[Star Wars: The Last Jedi Activity Book with Stickers]]'' {{Po}} *''[[Star Wars: The Last Jedi: The Visual Dictionary]]'' *''[[Star Wars: The Last Jedi: Ultimate Sticker Collection]]'' *''[[The Art of Star Wars: The Last Jedi]]'' *''[[Star Wars: The Complete Visual Dictionary, New Edition]]'' *{{SWKidsYouTube|series=Star Wars By the Numbers|text=Every Droid in Star Wars|video=UQg6aX7lqTA|nolive=1}} *{{Databank|neepers-panpick|Neepers Panpick}} ==Notes and references== {{Reflist}} {{Interlang |fr=Neepers Panpick |ja=ニーパース・パンピック |pl=Neepers Panpick }} {{DEFAULTSORT:Panpick, Neepers}} [[Category:Detectives]] [[Category:Individuals of unidentified species]] [[Category:Males]] [[Category:Private investigators]]
